title: Religious beliefs are not personal beliefs

top_liked.author: @jwoods5460
top_liked.text: I completely agree. Thank you for pointing this out.

top_liked.author: @jordanwhite8718
top_liked.text: I feel that even with personal beliefs, they should be challenged. If your beliefs can’t stand scrutiny, then they’re not worth holding onto. Obviously don’t harass people or go crazy with it but just because you have a strong personal belief doesn’t mean it shouldn’t be…

top_liked.author: @FaithExposed
top_liked.text:
Great points! I've been accused of this as well, but it seems like a dangerous concept to think that certain ideas shouldn't be challenged.  Why shouldn't we challenge people's beliefs? Especially when they are so impactful on people around them.  

There is a huge problem…

top_liked.author: @ChipPayet
top_liked.text:
Exactly! Once your religious beliefs impact others, they are no longer personal. 

Kind of like the old line, “Your right to smoke stops at the tip of my nose.”  Right!

top_liked.author: @connornoel2138
top_liked.text: if you want to impose your beliefs on others, they have the right to resist
